process_area.title: Corporate Legal Advisory, Contracts & Risk Governance

value_stream.name: Legal Operations, Litigation & Intellectual Property Management

fields.Participants: Legal Ops Mgr, In-House Counsel, Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Sales (links to VS-11), VP Legal & Compliance
fields.Trigger: New contract type; legal-review request; template refresh

workflows.name: Contract Template, Clause Library & Legal Review Support

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "approved clause alternatives" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review support for non-standard contracts" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-capture of "Capture learnings into templates" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-531 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Legal Advisory, Contracts & Risk Governance (PA-100.3).)
- operational: review SLA and clause standards; operational: annual refresh and regulatory monitoring (links to VS-22)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-standard-contract risk: Unmanaged redlines introduce hidden risk; mitigated by review SLA and clause standards**
- **Template-staleness risk: Outdated clauses fail to reflect law/market; mitigated by annual refresh and regulatory monitoring (links to VS-22.3)**
System Touchpoints: - Contract template/CMS (links to VS-22/VS-88); procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34); privacy (links to VS-91); anti-bribery (links to VS-86.3)
Time Estimate: - Per contract review; annual template cycle

steps.activity: Legal Ops Mgr/In-House Counsel maintain contract template library and clause library: standard templates by type (vendor MSA per VS-03, customer/trade per VS-11, lease as lessee per VS-42 and lessor per VS-97, NDA per W3270, employment per VS-19, IP license per W3269), approved clause alternatives (limitation of liability, indemnity, termination, governing law, dispute resolution/ADR per W3260); version and publish

Provide legal review support for non-standard contracts: triage incoming contracts (redlines, third-party paper), assess risk (commercial, legal, compliance, data-privacy per VS-91, anti-bribery per VS-86.3), negotiate key clauses, approve or escalate per authority matrix (links to VS-22 contract review W230)

Capture learnings into templates: incorporate recurring issues, regulatory changes (links to VS-22.3), and dispute lessons (W3264) into clause library and templates; train business users on self-service of standard templates and escalation triggers

fields.Participants: Legal Ops Mgr, Business Owner, Procurement (links to VS-34), Finance, Records (links to VS-88)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Legal Ops Mgr register executed contracts in contract repository" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "route to responsible business owner for action" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor performance against terms, flag breaches, manage amendments/change…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-154 (ensure legal matter & IP portfolio control.)
- operational: alerts and calendar; operational: obligation register
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missed-renewal risk: Auto-renewals or missed renewals create cost/gap; mitigated by alerts and calendar**
- **Obligation-blindness risk: Untracked obligations (audit rights, SLAs) cost value/protection; mitigated by obligation register**
System Touchpoints: - Contract lifecycle/CMS (links to VS-34.2/VS-88); master data (links to VS-29); insurance (links to VS-26)

steps.activity: Legal Ops Mgr register executed contracts in contract repository: parties, type, value, term, key obligations, renewal/expiry, governing law, special conditions; link to source documents (links to VS-88) and vendor/customer master (links to VS-29)

Track obligations and milestones: automated alerts for renewals, price-adjustment windows, notice deadlines, audit rights, insurance-certificate renewals (links to VS-26), compliance certifications; route to responsible business owner for action

Manage contract performance and disputes: monitor performance against terms, flag breaches, manage amendments/change orders, initiate dispute resolution (W3260/W3257) where needed; archive at termination (links to VS-88)

fields.Participants: Corporate Secretary, VP Legal & Compliance, Legal Ops Mgr, Finance (links to VS-17/VS-36), External Counsel
fields.Trigger: Entity event (new entity, amendment, dissolution); board/secretarial need; annual cycle
fields.Volume: 5 legal entities (Holdings, Depot, Logistics, Digital Commerce, Property Mgmt)

workflows.name: Legal Entity Management & Corporate Secretarial Support

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Corporate Secretary maintain entity register and statutory records" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "Manage entity events" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-generate of "prepare board/committee materials, manage meetings and minutes, resolutions and…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-531 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Legal Advisory, Contracts & Risk Governance (PA-100.3).)
- operational: corporate calendar; operational: single entity master (links to VS-29)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-filing risk: Missed SEC/BIR/LGU filings trigger penalties and good-standing issues; mitigated by corporate calendar**
- **Inconsistent-records risk: Entity records out of sync across systems; mitigated by single entity master (links to VS-29)**
System Touchpoints: - Entity/governance (links to VS-36); records (links to VS-88); permits (links to VS-22); tax (links to VS-79)

steps.activity: Corporate Secretary maintain entity register and statutory records: SEC registration (Articles, By-laws, GIS per VS-36), General Information Sheet filings, board/stockholder minutes and resolutions (links to VS-36.1), officer/director register, permits/licenses (links to VS-22.1), foreign-investment filings where applicable

Manage entity events: incorporation, amendment of articles, change of officers/directors, increase/decrease in capital, mergers/dissolutions, name change; coordinate SEC filings and LGU/BIR updates (links to VS-76/VS-79); maintain corporate calendar

Support corporate secretarial operations for board governance (links to VS-36.1): prepare board/committee materials, manage meetings and minutes, resolutions and authorities (links to VS-36), corporate disclosures; coordinate with VS-36 corporate-governance value stream

fields.Participants: VP Legal & Compliance, Litigation Counsel, Legal Ops Mgr, Compliance (links to VS-22), Business Owners, External Counsel, Authorities (BIR, DOLE, DENR, DTI, NPC, NBI, PNP, BOC, LGU, AMLC)

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "VP Legal & Compliance scope and coordinate response" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Manage internal investigation and government response" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update risk register" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-531 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Legal Advisory, Contracts & Risk Governance (PA-100.3).)
- operational: prompt response and remediation; operational: counsel-led investigation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adverse-finding risk: Substantive findings, penalties, reputational damage; mitigated by prompt response and remediation**
- **Privilege-waiver risk: Mishandled internal investigation waives privilege; mitigated by counsel-led investigation**
System Touchpoints: - Matter/investigation docket (W3279); records/e-discovery (links to VS-88/W3262); compliance (links to VS-22); risk register (links to VS-21.2)
Time Estimate: - Per inquiry; months–years for major investigations

steps.activity: VP Legal & Compliance scope and coordinate response: assess authority/subject (tax per VS-79, labor per VS-84, environment per VS-73/VS-25, consumer/DTI per VS-13, privacy/NPC per VS-91, AML/AMLC per VS-86, customs/BOC per VS-87, anti-bribery per VS-86.3), privileges and strategy, engagement of external counsel, internal investigation team; manage search-warrant execution (privilege, scope)

Manage internal investigation and government response: preserve documents (litigation hold W3262), conduct privileged investigation, respond to subpoenas/document requests (links to VS-88 e-discovery), manage witness interviews and government interactions; assess exposure and remediation

Resolve and remediate: negotiate settlement/consent order where warranted, manage penalties (links to VS-15), implement corrective actions and controls to prevent recurrence, update risk register (links to VS-21.2) and disclosures (W3277); capture lessons
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Compliance / Business Owners

fields.Participants: VP Legal & Compliance, Finance (links to VS-17), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Audit (links to VS-21/VS-22.2), Board (links to VS-36.1)
fields.Trigger: Period-end; new matter (W3257); material development; audit

workflows.name: Legal Risk Register, Loss Contingency & Disclosure

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "enterprise risk register" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "coordinate audit support" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "Report to board/audit committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-531 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Legal Advisory, Contracts & Risk Governance (PA-100.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-disclosure risk: Inadequate contingency disclosure attracts audit/SEC scrutiny; mitigated by PAS 37 (IAS 37) discipline**
- **Risk-register-disconnect risk: Legal risks not in enterprise register → blind spots; mitigated by integration**
System Touchpoints: - Risk register (links to VS-21.2); finance/contingency (links to VS-17); audit (links to VS-22.2); board (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: VP Legal & Compliance/Risk maintain legal-risk register: contingent and pending legal risks (litigation W3258, regulatory W3276, IP W3268, contract W3274, labor per VS-84, tax per VS-79), likelihood/impact assessment, owner, mitigation, status; integrate to enterprise risk register (links to VS-21.2)

Finance/VP Legal & Compliance assess and disclose loss contingencies per PFRS/IAS 37 (W3261): probable/possible/remote classification, accrue or disclose, contingency notes to financial statements, related-party and commitments disclosures; coordinate audit support (links to VS-22.2) and consolidation (links to VS-17.2)

Report to board/audit committee (links to VS-36.1): legal-risk portfolio, material contingencies, reserve movements, disclosures; obtain required oversight/approvals; manage material non-public information confidentiality

fields.Participants: VP Legal & Compliance, Internal Audit (links to VS-21), Compliance (links to VS-22/VS-86.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-84), Loss Prevention (links to VS-23), Investigations Team
fields.Trigger: Whistleblower report (via channel per VS-22.1); ethics concern; mandatory disclosure

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "log case with pseudonymous ID, protect reporter anonymity and anti-retaliation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documents, data, interviews — links to VS-23.1 investigation methodology, CCTV…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-register of "Resolve and remediate" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-531 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Legal Advisory, Contracts & Risk Governance (PA-100.3).)
- operational: anti-retaliation policy and monitoring (per VS-22); operational: trained investigators and counsel oversight
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retaliation risk: Reporter suffers retaliation; mitigated by anti-retaliation policy and monitoring (per VS-22.1)**
- **Investigation-integrity risk: Mishandled investigation compromises findings/privilege; mitigated by trained investigators and counsel oversight**
System Touchpoints: - Whistleblower case management (links to VS-22.1); investigation (links to VS-23/VS-21); HR (links to VS-19); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Receive and triage reports: intake via whistleblower channel (anonymous-capable per VS-22.1), log case with pseudonymous ID, protect reporter anonymity and anti-retaliation (per VS-22.1), triage by severity/credibility, assign investigator and privileged handling where legal-investigation warranted
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Compliance / Internal Audit

steps.activity: Conduct investigation: plan scope, collect evidence (documents, data, interviews — links to VS-23.1 investigation methodology, CCTV per VS-23.2, system logs per VS-27.3), interview witnesses/subjects with due-process safeguards, coordinate with HR (employee discipline per VS-19/VS-84) and Loss Prevention (theft/fraud per VS-23); manage privileged internal investigation where exposure is material

Resolve and remediate: substantiated findings → disciplinary action (HR), recovery (civil/criminal per W3257), regulatory self-disclosure where required (W3276), corrective actions and controls; close case with documentation; feed analytics (W3280) and risk register (links to VS-21.2); protect against retaliation

fields.Participants: Legal Ops Mgr, IT (links to VS-27/VS-99), Finance, VP Legal & Compliance, Vendors
fields.Trigger: System need; vendor invoice; technology refresh

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Legal Ops Mgr/IT" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "center" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review of tech stack for optimization" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-531 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Legal Advisory, Contracts & Risk Governance (PA-100.3).)
- operational: security controls (links to VS-27); operational: training and adoption metrics
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-security risk: Legal data (privileged, personal) breach exposure; mitigated by security controls (links to VS-27.3/VS-91)**
- **Technology-underutilization risk: Powerful tools underused; mitigated by training and adoption metrics**
System Touchpoints: - Legal-ops platform/e-billing; IT/security (links to VS-27/VS-99); privacy (links to VS-91); finance (links to VS-17)

steps.activity: Legal Ops Mgr/IT (links to VS-27) operate legal-technology stack: matter-management (W3257), e-billing and spend management (W3259), e-discovery (links to VS-88 W2990), contract lifecycle management (W3273/W3274), IP docket (PA-100.2), legal-hold (W3262), whistleblower/ethics case (W3278); integrate with ERP/document systems (links to VS-88)

Manage e-billing: route outside-counsel invoices through e-billing system, enforce billing guidelines and rate cards (W3259), automated checks (duplicate, rate, disallowable expenses), approvals, allocation to matter/entity/cost center (links to VS-72), analytics on spend

Govern legal-technology: vendor management (W3255-style for legal-tech vendors), data privacy/security (links to VS-27.3/VS-91 — legal data is highly sensitive), access controls, periodic review of tech stack for optimization; manage legal-tech budget (W3280)

fields.Participants: Legal Ops Mgr, VP Legal & Compliance, Finance (links to VS-17.4), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Board (links to VS-36.1)
fields.Trigger: Quarterly legal review; budget cycle; board reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Legal Ops Mgr/Finance compile legal-department analytics" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-forecast of "forecast vs budget" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture, prevention initiatives, value delivered" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-531 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Legal Advisory, Contracts & Risk Governance (PA-100.3).)
- operational: e-billing and analytics; operational: prevention analytics and contract/policy improvement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-opaque risk: Legal spend not visible/managed; mitigated by e-billing and analytics**
- **Prevention-blindness risk: Reactive legal spend without prevention; mitigated by prevention analytics and contract/policy improvement**
System Touchpoints: - Legal analytics/e-billing (W3279); finance (links to VS-17.4); risk register (links to VS-21.2); board (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Legal Ops Mgr/Finance compile legal-department analytics: matter portfolio (W3264), outside-counsel spend and efficiency, in-house productivity (matters/counsel, cycle time), loss-contingency movement (W3277), enforcement outcomes (W3268), contract review throughput (W3273), whistleblower case metrics (W3278)

Manage legal budget and cost: in-house comp, outside-counsel spend (W3259), legal-tech (W3279), court/fees, settlements/judgments (W3261); forecast vs budget (links to VS-33/VS-17.4), identify cost drivers and efficiency opportunities (in-source work, fixed-fee, prevention)

Report to executive committee and board (links to VS-36.1): legal-department performance, cost, risk posture, prevention initiatives, value delivered (recovery, avoidance); drive continuous improvement and preventive legal strategy
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Legal Ops Mgr
